description: This source file defines a custom ListView component called DynamicListView that supports drag-and-drop reordering of list items through touch interactions. It maintains internal states, manages visual overlays of selected items, handles touch events, swaps list elements, and manages smooth scrolling during dragging. The class is closely tied to Android UI frameworks, specifically customizing ListView behavior with touch and animation logic.

classes.name: DynamicListView
classes.description: A custom ListView subclass supporting drag-and-swap functionality with animated feedback and auto-scrolling when dragging near edges.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the listview, setting up listeners and parameters.

methods.name: mOnItemLongClickListener
methods.description: Handles long click events on list items to initiate dragging.

methods.name: getAndAddHoverView
methods.description: Creates a bitmap overlay of the selected item for dragging visualization.

methods.name: getBitmapWithBorder
methods.description: Adds a border around the item's bitmap for visual clarity.

methods.name: getBitmapFromView
methods.description: Generates a bitmap snapshot of a list item view.

methods.name: updateNeighborViewsForID
methods.description: Updates references to views above and below the current draggable item.

methods.name: getViewForID
methods.description: Fetches the list item view associated with a specific item ID.

methods.name: getPositionForID
methods.description: Returns the positional index of an item given its ID.

methods.name: dispatchDraw
methods.description: Overrides drawing method to render the drag overlay bitmap atop list items.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch interactions for dragging, moving, and releasing list items.

methods.name: handleCellSwitch
methods.description: Determines if a list item should be swapped during dragging based on position.

methods.name: swapElements
methods.description: Swaps two elements in the data list representing the list items.

methods.name: touchEventsEnded
methods.description: Finalizes the drag operation, animates the overlay into place, and resets states.

methods.name: touchEventsCancelled
methods.description: Cancels ongoing drag operations, restoring original states.

methods.name: isScrollCompleted
methods.description: Checks if ongoing scrollings are complete to proceed with animation.

methods.name: checkAndHandleFirstVisibleCellChange
methods.description: Handles logic when the first visible list item changes due to scrolling.

methods.name: checkAndHandleLastVisibleCellChange
methods.description: Handles logic when the last visible list item changes due to scrolling.
